Scenario: Gridlock Gulch

Gridlock Gulch has two crossroads, one highway through town and a lot of impatient drivers. Keep them moving and the town will grow.

Objective: reach 800 residents with a Traffic Rating of at least 650 by the end of February, Year 3.

The town is split into Residential (R), Commercial (C) and Industrial (I) districts. Residents commute from R to jobs in C and I each morning and drive home each evening, and that commute is the traffic. Use the R, C and I tools to zone land where the demand bars are high. Plain junctions let one direction through at a time. Roundabouts are cheap and never show red. Signals move the most traffic, and the Inspect tool lets you re-time them or make them adaptive. Avenues carry twice the cars. Bus stops take drivers off the road. One-way streets, protected left turns and green waves squeeze more out of busy corridors. Count stations and the reports window show exactly where and when traffic peaks. Parks raise land value; congestion lowers it. Overlays (H) show congestion, land value, junction Level of Service (LOS) and yesterday's peak.

Every car on the road is a resident. In the morning they drive from Residential (R) to jobs in Commercial (C) and Industrial (I), shoppers head to C through the day, and in the evening everyone drives home. Keep the three districts connected by good roads, and zone more land wherever demand is high.
